summary: Consumers Energy Company filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of $900 million aggregate principal amount of First Mortgage Bonds, comprising $450 million of 4.900% bonds due 2031 and $450 million of 6.100% bonds due 2056, under an existing shelf registration statement. The offering was made under an underwriting agreement dated July 30, 2026, with several underwriters including BofA Securities and Goldman Sachs. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation, so no further analysis is required.
